description: Written and directed by Sreeti Mukerji, the coming-of-age film centers on Shyamili “Shy” Das, a 20-year-old whose meticulously organized life begins to unravel when an unexpected turn of events sends things spiraling beyond her control. Mukerji previously worked on the direction teams of Bollywood hits “Yeh Jawaani Hai Deewani,” “Ae Dil Hai Mushkil” and “Brahmastra Part One: Shiva.”

cast.name: 阿莉雅·布哈特 Alia Bhatt
